decision.explanation: The provided documents contain contradictory assertions regarding the artist of the album 'Free Your Mind'. Document D1 (and associated cards) explicitly identifies the artist as 'Cut Copy', stating it is their fourth studio album. Conversely, Document D4 (and associated cards) asserts the artist is 'The Beatles', describing them as an 'electronic music band' releasing the same album on the same date. Additionally, Document D3 contains a citation headline claiming 'The Beatles Announce New Album Free Your Mind'. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat all audits/saved answers as fallible without inventing source authority, both 'Cut Copy' and 'The Beatles' are retained as distinct valid answers based on the conflicting source texts.
